summary_en: This study tests pembrolizumab given together with 177Lu-PSMA-617, a PSMA-targeted radionuclide therapy, in men with metastatic castration-resistant prostate cancer. Pembrolizumab is given IV at 400 mg every 6 weeks, and 177Lu-PSMA-617 is given by IV infusion at 7.4 GBq on Cycle 1 Day 1 and 6 weeks later, then at the first later PSA rise, for up to six total doses with at least 6 weeks between doses. The main outcome is not stated; this is a Phase 2 study.
summary_es: Este estudio evalúa pembrolizumab administrado junto con 177Lu-PSMA-617, una terapia con radionúclidos dirigida a PSMA, en hombres con cáncer de próstata metastásico resistente a la castración. El pembrolizumab se administra por vía intravenosa a 400 mg cada 6 semanas, y el 177Lu-PSMA-617 se administra por infusión intravenosa de 7.4 GBq el Día 1 del Ciclo 1 y 6 semanas después, y luego en el primer aumento posterior del PSA, hasta seis dosis en total, con al menos 6 semanas entre dosis. El resultado principal no está indicado; este es un estudio de Fase 2.
who_for: Men 18 years or older with metastatic castration-resistant prostate cancer that is progressing.
Prior progression on at least one second generation androgen signaling inhibitor.
At least one PSMA PET-avid lesion on the screening scan.
ECOG performance status of 1 or lower.
Adequate blood cell counts, liver function, and kidney function.
not_for: De novo small cell neuroendocrine prostate cancer.
Prior anti-PD-1, anti-PD-L1, or anti-PD-L2 therapy, or other T-cell checkpoint agent therapy.
Untreated brain metastases at study entry.
Active autoimmune disease that required systemic treatment within the past 2 years.
